Kv.unit: m³/h at 1 bar reference pressure drop

assumptions: Synthetic values, not measurements or catalogue Kvs for valve 522.
Fixed opening; incompressible Newtonian fluid; sufficiently turbulent flow; no cavitation, flashing or choking.
Same pressure-measurement boundary; no additional pipe-fitting correction; SG uses a 1000 kg/m³ reference.
CdA uses an additional simplified orifice model and is an equivalent product, not actual seat area.
Do not apply this constant-coefficient square-root law directly to the Re≈10 diagnostic.
inference_limit: Only the product Cd*A is constrained in this model; many geometries and coefficients fit it. No actual seat diameter, tolerance, preload, material or product qualification is identified.
